trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) WHERE p.name <> 'Toby Kimball' AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 2 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) >= 0 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <> 1 RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS col1, p.nba_championships AS col2, p.college AS col3, p.name AS name_player
